subject: Contact Management System Ready for Maintenance Log Integration

content.capability_summary: Contact Management System ready to accept service provider data from maintenance log entries and auto-suggest contact creation.

maintenance_log_id.description: Reference to S2-H03 maintenance log entry

name.description: Service provider name (extracted from maintenance log)

role.description: Service provider role (auto-mapped from service_type if possible)

phone.description: Provider phone number (if available in log)

workflow.step_1_trigger: S2-H03 maintenance log entry created with service provider details
workflow.step_2_extraction: S2-H03 extracts provider name, service type, phone, email
workflow.step_3_api_call: S2-H03 calls POST /api/contacts/suggest with extracted data
workflow.step_4_processing: S2-H05 processes suggestion, performs fuzzy matching, creates suggestion record
workflow.step_5_response: S2-H05 returns suggestion ID and matching options
workflow.step_6_user_action: User reviews suggestion in Contact Management UI
workflow.step_7_confirmation: User chooses: Create, Merge, or Skip
workflow.step_8_linkage: S2-H05 updates contact and creates bidirectional link to maintenance_log_id

features.fuzzy_matching: Automatically detect similar provider names to suggest merging
features.auto_role_detection: Map maintenance service_type to contact role
features.suggestions_storage: All suggestions stored in contact_suggestions table for audit
features.bidirectional_linking: Link contact to maintenance log entry upon acceptance

next_steps.s2_h03_action_1: Implement extraction of provider details from maintenance log entries
next_steps.s2_h03_action_2: Add integration logic to call POST /api/contacts/suggest endpoint
next_steps.s2_h03_action_3: Implement fallback for cases where provider not fully specified
next_steps.s2_h05_action_1: Implement fuzzy matching algorithm for contact deduplication
next_steps.s2_h05_action_2: Create UI suggestions panel in Contact Management interface
next_steps.s2_h05_action_3: Implement batch processing for high-volume suggestions

success_criteria.automation: 95% of provider mentions in maintenance log auto-suggest contacts
success_criteria.accuracy: 90% of suggestions are valid contacts (user acceptance rate)
success_criteria.deduplication: Fuzzy matching prevents duplicate contacts for same provider
success_criteria.linkage: All accepted suggestions create proper maintenance_log <-> contact links
